what: On hover over a photo link, the cropped edges of the photo shrink inward by 10px on all four sides, leaving a border margin, and it fades slightly to .9 (.5s with a .1s delay). On release it fills back in reverse

options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo to shrink (the element itself if none)
options.--fx-ease: Curve (via style), default cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) — Brand cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)
options.look: ”round” — crops while keeping the rounded corners (clip-path inset round). Corner is --fx-radius, default var(--kf-radius-md)
options.[data-fx-part=zoom]: Photo that approaches together inside media (optional) — --fx-zoom times, default 1.05

from.where: shared.css .nc-lcard·index.html feature banner·strength photo (original component.css a:hover .c-link-anim-img / page.min.css a:hover .c-anim-img)

shared.css .sq-shot (News·Brand·Interview cards — original .c-news-item-figure·.service-products-item-img: clip-path inset(0 round 8px) → inset(5px round 8px), inner photo 1.05x, .4s expo-out with no delay, no opacity change)
from.options: look: round · style="--fx-inset: 5px; --fx-dim: 1; --fx-dur: .4s; --fx-delay: 0s; --fx-ease: cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1); --fx-radius: 8px" · data-fx-part on the photo="zoom"
